result.detail: The GPU experiment reused the committed split, negative sampling and metric code: 11,567 target-disease positives, 20% held out (9,253 train / 2,314 test), five negatives per positive, seeds 0-4, 200-sample bootstrap, and no held-out edge in message passing. The report checks zero held-out edges in training and zero feature leakage in all three arms. Hits@10 is 1.0 for every arm, so arm comparison rests on macro/micro AUPRC and MRR; the result is a within-graph ablation, not a comparison against the hosted Pharos graph.
result.numbers: 11,567 positives; 9,253 train; 2,314 test; negatives per positive 5; seeds 0-4; bootstrap 200; 4,999 evaluated pairs; 2,685 negatives; held-out-in-training 0
